pr_title: Bluetooth: Controller: Fix incorrect event_count when CIG overlaps
pr_body:
Fix incorrect event_count use in CIG events when the next
CIG interval's prepare overlaps with the current CIG event.
Use separate event_count_prepare variable in ULL and copy
the value in LLL event.

Fixes #83584.

Other miscellaneous improvements:
- Fix Connected ISO to use accumulated latency to update the
payload count.
- Fix incorrect elapsed events value when event prepare are
aborted in the pipeline. This can caused premature
supervision timeouts.
Relates to commit https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/commit/247037bd3e2ab6f137bcc02d6e0f10f4dcfa9c99 ("Bluetooth: Controller: Fix
incorrect elapsed events value").

issue_context.title: Bluetooth: Controller: ISO: CIS MIC errors commonly occur
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
It has become a common occurrence to see MIC errors causing CIS disconnects (reason 0x3d (`BT_HCI_ERR_TERM_DUE_TO_MIC_FAIL`)) in various configurations. These are often found in the LE Audio tests. They occur with both unidirectional and bidirectional configurations and with both a single peripheral and multiple peripherals. 

**To Reproduce**
1. Apply https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/83539
2. Run https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/main/tests/bsim/bluetooth/audio/compile.sh
3. Run any of the tests that disabled in that PR marked with "reason 0x3d"

**Expected behavior**
Expect to see no MIC errors when sending audio on a CIS on an encrypted ACL. 

**Impact**
Significant as it occurs often and seemingly not something that is fixable by the application. Causes CI issues.

comments: Is this reproducible on target devices or it is just issue with bsim testing? Which sample can I use on target to reproduce and analyze the MIC failure?

I haven't tried to replicate on target. Given the semi-randomness of this issue, it's likely timing related, but I can try to replicate it with the shell. I don't think any of the existing samples run with the configurations that is causing issues
FWIW, I'm getting the same error (0x3d - Connection terminated due to MIC failure) when trying to stream audio from an Android Pixel 7a to the PTS dongle with new firmware 13.33137.0.0.

@cvinayak It can easily be reproduced on target using https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/84507. Just flash https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/tree/main/samples/bluetooth/cap_acceptor on one device, and https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/tree/main/samples/bluetooth/cap_initiator on another device using that PR, and then you should see the error on the peripheral
Reopening as we see this happening again in https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/87030

@Thalley On analysis of one of the failure, it is confirmed that the MIC failure is symptom of a bug in the payload counter for the second CIS being established on a device. Will work on a fix on the next opportunity :-)

review_comments:
`event_count_prepare` is initialized to `LLL_CONN_ISO_EVENT_COUNT_MAX` but unconditionally incremented here. 

Does this not risk overflowing the counter? Is that intentional?
yes, intentional to rollover and take the value `0` on the very first (and corresponding in case of skipped) ISO interval event.

Can I bother you to add a comment stating that? 

Generally, unless completely obvious, I do prefer when overflows are intentional that they are documented as well, so this won't be considered a bug by someone else :)
